answer: Resist sybils with bonded service contracts: each identity acts only under a contract backed by a bond and judged by independent arbitrators. A terrace of standing is built contract by contract, each jade-stamped with delivered work and client sign-off. Breach forfeits the bond and voids that history. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes must fund ten thousand bonds and deliver ten thousand real services, since empty contracts earn nothing and failed ones burn capital. Reaching the zenith needs a long record of honored contracts, while an honest agent signs one and keeps its standing.
